jobgether-jobgether:lever:6fa22cf7-e8c2-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Azure Data Engineer based in France. This role offers the opportunity to strengthen cybersecurity operations by engineering reliable, scalable security data pipelines across cloud and on-premises environments. You will work with high volumes of security telemetry and help ensure critical data is available for threat detection, incident response, compliance, and cyber risk visibility. The position combines hands-on data engineering with cybersecurity, cloud technologies, automation, and data quality management. You’ll collaborate with application, infrastructure, security, governance, and vendor teams to onboard and optimize diverse data sources. The role is well suited to an engineer who enjoys troubleshooting complex ingestion challenges and improving system reliability and efficiency. You’ll operate in a highly regulated financial services environment where data integrity, security, and operational excellence are essential. This is an opportunity to make a direct impact on the organization’s ability to detect, investigate, and respond to cyber threats. Design, build, and maintain scalable security data ingestion pipelines for SIEM and cloud data platforms, including Azure Data Explorer and Log Analytics. Parse, normalize, transform, enrich, and validate structured and unstructured security telemetry using regex, JSON parsing, schema mapping, and other data-processing techniques. Partner with application owners, infrastructure and cloud teams, vendors, security stakeholders, and other internal groups to onboard new log sources and validate end-to-end data flows. Ensure the integrity, completeness, timeliness, and quality of security telemetry used for monitoring, detection, incident response, reporting, and risk management. Align security data with established schemas, naming conventions, governance standards, and organizational requirements to support downstream analytics and automation. Troubleshoot ingestion, parsing, transformation, schema, and data-quality issues across diverse platforms and environments. Maintain clear documentation covering log onboarding procedures, source requirements, data mappings, pipeline configurations, and operational support processes. Collaborate with detection engineering and security operations teams to ensure telemetry supports investigation, threat detection, response, and cyber risk use cases. Conduct telemetry gap analyses, identify missing or incomplete data sources, and recommend priorities for improving security coverage. Support logging practices that meet regulatory, audit, compliance, retention, and data-integrity requirements. Improve ingestion frameworks, automation, and onboarding processes to increase scalability, repeatability, reliability, and cost efficiency. Support infrastructure-as-code, scripting, and automation initiatives that streamline deployment and ongoing pipeline maintenance. Monitor pipeline performance and work with stakeholders to optimize ingestion reliability, throughput, and operational costs. Stay current with emerging cybersecurity telemetry formats, logging standards, data engineering practices, and cloud security data-platform capabilities. Requirements: 3+ years of relevant experience in cybersecurity, data engineering, log management, security operations, or a related technology discipline. Hands-on experience onboarding, managing, and validating log sources within SIEM, cloud data platforms, or security analytics environments. Strong understanding of data parsing, normalization, transformation, and validation, including experience with regex, JSON, XML, CSV, and both structured and unstructured data. Familiarity with security telemetry from network, endpoint, identity, application, cloud, and infrastructure environments. jobgether-jobgether:lever:87f447a5-2918-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Director, Data Strategy based in the United States. The Director, Data Strategy will shape and advance data strategies across two critical functional areas: Customer Engagement and Integrated Marketing. This role translates business priorities into actionable data roadmaps, capability investments, and measurable outcomes across a complex enterprise environment. You will identify shared data needs, uncover gaps, and create opportunities to reuse governed data assets across brands, channels, and therapeutic areas. The position requires close collaboration with business leaders, analytics teams, data governance, technology, vendors, and other data strategy stakeholders. You will help strengthen customer engagement, omnichannel activation, field execution, marketing effectiveness, segmentation, and integrated customer experiences through better use of data. Success will depend on your ability to balance strategic priorities, manage a portfolio of data capabilities, and influence senior stakeholders in a matrixed organization. This is an opportunity to turn enterprise data strategy into scalable capabilities that deliver measurable business value across the U.S. organization. Lead the functional data strategy for Customer Engagement and Integrated Marketing, defining strategic priorities, roadmaps, capability requirements, and success measures aligned with broader enterprise objectives. Develop data strategies that enable stronger customer engagement, omnichannel activation, field execution, marketing effectiveness, segmentation, and integrated customer experiences across brands and channels. Identify common horizontal data requirements while clearly distinguishing them from therapeutic area, brand, indication, launch, and lifecycle-specific needs. Ensure functional priorities are appropriately represented in enterprise and therapeutic-area roadmaps while avoiding duplication of responsibilities or capabilities. Translate business priorities into clear data requirements, capability priorities, investment recommendations, and measurable outcomes. Partner with Insights & Analytics, Data Partnerships, Data Governance, Data Quality, technology, procurement, vendors, and business stakeholders to align on priorities and execution. Evaluate external data sources, partnerships, platforms, and vendors to identify opportunities to strengthen data capabilities and maximize the value of external data assets. Help manage data-related risks, including privacy, security, quality, compliance, and appropriate use of external data. Drive transparency across the functional data portfolio through roadmap views, KPI summaries, executive updates, investment recommendations, and trade-off assessments. Promote reuse, governance, adoption, and continuous improvement of priority data assets and capabilities. Establish adoption plans and value measures that demonstrate the business impact of strategic data investments. Build strong relationships with senior stakeholders and facilitate alignment across a complex, cross-functional and matrixed environment. Monitor industry trends, data partnership practices, and evolving capabilities to continuously strengthen the organization’s data strategy. Strong understanding of life sciences data ecosystems and how data sources, governance requirements, business needs, and enterprise capabilities interact across functions. jobgether-jobgether:lever:8b132aa5-ce4d-.title: Technical Support Engineer
jobgether-jobgether:lever:8b132aa5-ce4d-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Technical Support Engineer based in Netherlands. As a Technical Support Engineer, you will be a key technical resource for enterprise customers across the EMEA region, helping them resolve complex issues and get maximum value from a sophisticated ecommerce technology platform. You will own customer-facing support conversations across tickets, Slack, and calls, guiding customers from initial investigation through resolution. The role combines hands-on troubleshooting with exceptional communication, customer enablement, and continuous improvement of support operations. You will work extensively with APIs, SDKs, logs, event data, integrations, tagging, and implementation behavior to diagnose technical challenges. As an early member of a newly established support function, you will have significant influence over processes, documentation, automation, escalation paths, and team practices. You will partner closely with customers as well as Customer Success, Solutions, Product, Engineering, and other internal teams to resolve issues and share valuable product feedback. This is an ideal opportunity for a technically strong, customer-obsessed problem solver who wants to build scalable support practices while working with cutting-edge ecommerce and AI technology.

jobgether-jobgether:lever:aa77476d-5f8b-.title: Accounts Payable Specialist
jobgether-jobgether:lever:aa77476d-5f8b-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Accounts Payable Specialist based in United States. This is an opportunity to join a close-knit accounting team within a fast-growing healthcare technology environment. You will play a key role in keeping day-to-day financial operations accurate, timely, and compliant. The position has broad exposure to invoice processing, expense management, vendor relationships, cash planning, and financial controls. You will collaborate closely with Finance and Accounting colleagues and cross-functional stakeholders to resolve discrepancies and improve processes. The role requires strong analytical judgment, exceptional attention to detail, and the ability to stay organized in a dynamic startup setting. You will also contribute to audit activities, regulatory compliance, expense monitoring, and reporting requirements. This is a strong opportunity for an accounting professional who enjoys ownership, continuous improvement, and working in a mission-driven healthcare technology environment. Process and analyze invoices through Bill.com, ensuring accurate expense classification, payment terms, approvals, and timely payment processing. Manage employee expense processes using SAP Concur and Ramp, ensuring expenses are properly reviewed, recorded, and supported. Review vendor and contractor agreements to determine the appropriate accounting treatment for related expenses. Prepare and maintain expense amortization schedules for prepaid expenses and ensure accurate period-end accounting. Analyze weekly cash requirements and support effective cash planning and expense management. Ensure accounts payable activities comply with applicable accounting standards, laws, regulations, and internal controls. Review payments to healthcare providers and support compliance with applicable Sunshine Act requirements. Assist with internal and external audits by preparing documentation, reconciling information, and responding to auditor requests. Build and maintain strong vendor relationships while investigating and resolving invoice, payment, and account discrepancies. Partner with internal teams to resolve issues, improve communication, and identify opportunities to streamline financial processes. Monitor expenses against budgets and use accounting systems and reporting tools to maintain accurate financial information. Support timely preparation and filing of 1099 forms and other required financial documentation. Requirements: Bachelor's degree in Accounting or a related field, with 2–3 years of relevant accounting or accounts payable experience. Solid understanding of accounting principles, standards, and financial controls, ideally within healthcare, medical technology, software, or another regulated environment. Proficiency with NetSuite and Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets, with strong ability to analyze and organize financial data. SAP Concur experience is required , while experience with Bill.com and Ramp is a strong advantage. Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with exceptional attention to detail and a consistent focus on accuracy. Ability to work independently, take initiative, and manage responsibilities effectively in a fast-paced startup environment. Adaptability and comfort embracing changing priorities, processes, and business needs. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work effectively with vendors and internal stakeholders. Strong organizational and time-management skills, including the ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines. A collaborative mindset and willingness to contribute to process improvements and team objectives. Benefits: Base salary of $70,000–$80,000 USD , with the range adjusted according to location, experience, skills, and internal equity. 10% target annual bonus , bringing total target compensation to approximately $77,000–$88,000 USD . thrivowealth-thrivo-wealth:ashbyhq:83eea.description: THRIVO WEALTH PARTNERS AG Founding Engineer / Lead Architect ThrivoOS · Full-Time · Remote Europe · CET core hours 5–8+ years · Architecture ownership · Equity About Thrivo The independent wealth management industry is at an inflection point. AI, regulatory pressure, and a looming succession wave will determine which firms thrive — and which flounder — in the coming decade. Thrivo Wealth Partners AG is a Swiss holding company based in Zug. Our model: partnering with founder-led independent wealth managers across the DACH region, helping them scale — organically and non-organically — and providing shared technology infrastructure. We are the long-term partner for future-ready wealth managers. The Team Christopher Kraft has accompanied numerous IWM transitions as an investment banker at Perella Weinberg Partners and in leading European wealth platforms. Felix Lobkowicz is a repeat founder — five companies, one IPO — and leads product and technology at Thrivo. Finn Weise leads capital and governance with over a decade of experience building fintechs and financial platforms, previously at Morgan Stanley and European VC funds. On the board: Sebastian Henrichs, former CEO of FNZ Bank Germany — the leading wealth platform in the industry. Behind Thrivo Thrivo is backed by a circle of investors from the finance and fintech world — experienced operators, entrepreneurs, and family offices who understand this market and think long-term. A platform that promises long-term thinking to founders cannot itself be optimising for short-term returns. The wealth management market in Germany and Switzerland is digitising — more slowly than other sectors, but with real momentum now. Thrivo is building the technology infrastructure that underpins this transformation: a platform for founder-led wealth managers that deploys compliance automation, AI-assisted processes, and modern data architecture in a way that until now has only been available to large institutions. ThrivoOS is not another fintech dashboard. It is the operating system for a growing group of partner firms collectively managing several billion AUM. You build this — as the first technical full-time hire and the engineering lead. The Role You own the technical leadership of ThrivoOS. You set the architecture, coordinate the freelance senior engineer, and are the engineering constant in a project that bridges complex regulatory requirements — MiFID II, WpHG, BaFin — with modern AI infrastructure. You work directly with Felix Lobkowicz (CTO-in-function) on product vision and technical direction. The most important architectural decisions are yours. The architecture and stack have not been finalised — you will define them together with Felix and Tech advisors based on your experience and what is right for the platform. This is one of the few roles in DACH fintech where technical depth, genuine entrepreneurial ownership, and real equity participation come together.
